result.markdown:
For most small support teams, I'd recommend **Freshdesk or Help Scout**\.

Freshdesk is the best all-rounder if you want proper ticket management, automation and room to grow. Help Scout is better if you want a simpler, more personal customer-support experience without lots of complexity.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.
